faq.question: What is the Meta Ads & Lead Generation Specialist course?
faq.answer: The Meta Ads & Lead Generation Specialist course is an intensive, 8-week (64 guided hours) practical training program focused on paid Facebook and Instagram advertising. It teaches campaign architecture, Meta Advantage+ AI optimization, Instant Form lead funnels, Click-to-WhatsApp campaigns, creative testing, Meta Pixel tracking, and performance reporting centered on qualified business leads.

faq.question: Is this Meta Ads course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. The course begins with foundational principles, including Meta Business Portfolio setup, account organization, and campaign objectives, before progressing to advanced creative testing and conversion measurement. Practical exercises utilize guided simulations and business scenarios, requiring no prior advertising experience or personal budget.

faq.question: What are the course fees and duration?
faq.answer: The course duration is 8 Weeks (2 Months), comprising 64 instructional and practical lab hours. The fee is INR 9,900 (+ applicable GST), following Nova Skills' Truth in Pricing policy with transparent institutional pricing and zero fake countdown discounts.

faq.question: Does the course cover both Facebook and Instagram Ads?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn to manage unified advertising across Facebook and Instagram, including placement-specific creative adaptations for Facebook Feed, Instagram Feed, Stories, and Reels, as well as Meta Advantage+ automated placements.

faq.question: Will I learn Meta Advantage+ and AI-powered advertising?
faq.answer: Yes. The curriculum comprehensively covers Meta Advantage+ capabilities, including Advantage+ audience targeting, Advantage+ campaign structures, Advantage+ placements, automated creative features, and algorithmic budget optimization.

faq.question: Will I learn WhatsApp lead-generation campaigns?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 03 is dedicated to Lead Generation Systems & WhatsApp Funnels, covering Click-to-WhatsApp ad setup, conversation initiation, WhatsApp Business greeting workflows, lead qualification criteria, and CRM follow-up processes.

faq.question: Does the course teach Meta Pixel and Conversions API?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 05 covers Meta Events Manager, Meta Pixel implementation, standard and custom event tracking, browser vs server-side event concepts via Conversions API fundamentals, event deduplication, and privacy-durable custom audience retargeting.

faq.question: Are practical projects included?
faq.answer: Yes. You will complete three comprehensive portfolio deliverables: (1) a complete Meta Ads Admissions & Lead Generation Funnel, (2) a Six-Creative Ad Testing Matrix with multi-placement copy, and (3) a Performance Improvement Report with lead quality and CPL optimization analysis.

faq.question: Will I receive an official Meta Blueprint certification?
faq.answer: The course includes guided preparation through relevant Meta Blueprint learning resources and preparation for applicable Meta certification exams. Official Meta certifications are earned separately through Meta's authorized testing process (Pearson VUE). Nova Skills issues its accredited Certificate of Completion upon fulfilling all course practicals.

faq.question: What career opportunities are available after completing the course?
faq.answer: Graduates develop competencies aligned with roles such as Meta Ads Specialist, Facebook & Instagram Ads Executive, Junior Paid Social Specialist, Lead Generation Specialist, Paid Social Campaign Executive, and Performance Marketing Executive (Meta Ads Focus), as well as freelance client acquisition retainers. Placements depend on individual portfolio merit and interview performance.
